summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Blog CMS feature. Backend API tests (14/14 passed). Frontend admin tests (Create, Edit, Delete, Search, Filter) all passed. Public Blog page and Blog Detail page working correctly after fixing a Helmet title bug.

bugs_fixed.issue: Helmet title causing 'Uncaught runtime errors' when post.seo_title or post.title could be undefined
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed title to use template literal with fallback: `${post.seo_title || post.title || 'Blog Post'} — Suvidha Travel`

seed_data_creation: Seed post 'Top 10 Places to Visit in Ladakh' exists with slug=top-10-places-to-visit-in-ladakh
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog CMS feature fully tested. All CRUD operations work. Public blog at /blog shows published posts with Featured section. Blog detail at /blog/:slug renders markdown content correctly. SEO meta tags working.

admin_blog_sidebar.details: Blog button in CMS sidebar navigates to Blog Management page with stats (Total Posts, Published, Drafts)

create_blog_post.details: New Post button opens editor modal with 3 tabs (Content, Media & Details, SEO). All fields work: title, slug, excerpt, content with markdown toolbar, image, author, category, tags, featured toggle, status select, SEO fields with live score widget

edit_blog_post.details: Edit icon opens modal with pre-filled data. Changes persist after save

delete_blog_post.details: Delete icon shows confirmation modal with post title. Post removed from list after confirmation

search_filter.details: Search by title works. Status filter (Published/Draft) works. Category filter works

public_blog_page.details: Shows published posts with Featured section, category filter buttons, search input. Post cards display image, title, excerpt, date, category

blog_detail_page.details: Displays post title, category, tags, author, date, featured image, markdown content (headings, bold, italic, lists, quotes). Back to Blog link and Copy Link button work

seo_meta_tags.details: Page title includes SEO title. Meta description set from seo_description field

backend_api_crud.details: GET /api/blog/ (list), POST /api/blog/ (create), PUT /api/blog/{id} (update), DELETE /api/blog/{id} (delete), GET /api/blog/{slug} (get by slug), GET /api/blog/categories (categories list) - all working
